def_en: 1) to delight in, take pleasure in, desire, be pleased with
1a1a) to take pleasure in, delight in
1a1b) to delight, desire, be pleased to do
1a2a) to delight in, have pleasure in
kjv: [idiom] any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.
expl: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
